author: Drops
html:
No matter what happen, we have to be strong and face the world again.\
Life is a big battlefield and somewhere we will find people who will pin us down. But we have to make our best effort to stand again.

author: Mr. hættetrøje
html: Yeeaah, right on.... Always beleive in your self and what you do, no matter what other people might think.... and if you fall, get back on the horse again.... Great video, thanks for sharing
